subject: Application greys-out during client-side intensive tasks

messages.author: 0395e194dcba3ff3
messages.subject: Application greys-out during client-side intensive tasks
parts:
Hi,

I am running a quite resource-demanding shiny application here:
http://www.heatstarseq.roslin.ed.ac.uk/heatrnaseq/
Code is here, but I am not sure it is that helpful:
https://github.com/gdevailly/HeatStarSeq_gh/tree/master/application/heatrnaseq

It runs on shiny server open source edition, behind a proxy under Apache.
It runs fine when run locally or when accessed directly (not behind the proxy), as far as I understand (which is not that much, I am not managing the web-server).
It runs almost find behind the proxy with one particular quirk:
During a client-intensive task (we are updating two selectInput() from 100s of possible values to more than 4000), browser freeze a bit (5sec) then the whole application display a grey veil and is not communicating with the server anymore.

Any advice more than welcome.

I suspect it to be some kind of time-out disconnection: client is busy rendering the web-page, and stop communicating with the server for more than 5s (but less than 15s!).
The webserver admin tried to play with app_idle_timout value and with various Apache timeout without success (problem still occurring). He now suspects a memory issue. However, server memory is not an issue (>200Gb), and memory.limit() returns a sightly confusing "Inf".

Do you know how we can track what is happening on the server during the issue? So far we where not able to track anything.

Many thanks,

Guillaume

PS: here how to trigger the greying of the app:
1) go to http://www.heatstarseq.roslin.ed.ac.uk/heatrnaseq/
2) on the left, under section 1, select the dataset: "GTEx - all samples (human)". This should trigger a 30 second loading. Wait until the main panel displays: "More than 1100 experiments match your criteria..."
This dataset is by far the biggest dataset in our App, and the only one with which the problem is reproducible. We had several report of non-reproducible greying of the application that may be related to this.
3) select tab "Pairwise plot" on the left.

messages.subject: Re: Application greys-out during client-side intensive tasks
parts:
Here is a minimal app illustrating the issue:
https://gist.github.com/gdevailly/cb12cf3d8920020117d914714083a802
http://www.joshiapps.roslin.ed.ac.uk/application3/
It works fine as long as the number of element in the select input is low.
When it get bigger (>15.000 values), it freeze the client browser for a bit (10sec) then greys-out.

Thanks,
Guillaume

messages.subject: Re: Application greys-out during client-side intensive tasks
parts:
Here is the [annonimized] Apache log of the breaking event:

mod_dumpio.c(103): [client vv.xx.yy.zz:aaaaaaa] mod_dumpio:  dumpio_out (data-HEAP): HTTP/1.1 204 No Content\r\nDate: Thu, 02 Jun 2016 14:37:28 GMT\r\nServer: Apache/2.4.18 (Unix)\r\nCache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0\r\nAccess-Control-Allow-Origin: http://www.example.com\r\nVary: Origin\r\nAccess-Control-Allow-Credentials: true\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nKeep-Alive: timeout=120, max=99\r\nConnection: Keep-Alive\r\n\r\n

 

Don't have a version for shiny but it was installed on 2015-10-30 from GitHub.


So apparently, when the client browser is busy displaying the heavy selectInput(), it generates an error 204 No Content on our Apache server, and then connection is lost between the client and the server.

Any idea on how to fix that?


Thanks,


Guillaume
